fixed_distribution: uniform distance 0.3 to 10 metres throughout training
forward_definition: long to short putting stages; operational comparator, not a claim about conventional golf pedagogy
escalation_rule: hold if missing sensor, outside declared distance or friction range, or learned forward model standard error above 0.3 metres
primary_comparison: goal_proximal minus forward, paired by seed
inference_unit: independent training seed, with identical holdout cases shared across arms within seed
release_policy: offline synthetic research only; no robot control, model promotion or automatic publication of a superiority claim
